package student

import (
	"context"
	"testing"
	"time"

	"github.com/example/ms-student-service/internal/domain"
)

type learningEvidenceRepositoryStub struct {
	applied    bool
	assistance domain.TeacherAssistance
	calls      int
}

func (stub *learningEvidenceRepositoryStub) ApplyTeacherAssistance(_ context.Context, assistance domain.TeacherAssistance) (bool, error) {
	stub.calls++
	stub.assistance = assistance
	return stub.applied, nil
}

func TestApplyTeacherAssistanceValidatesBeforePersistence(t *testing.T) {
	repository := &learningEvidenceRepositoryStub{applied: true}
	useCase := ApplyTeacherAssistance{Evidence: repository}
	hintLevel := 2

	applied, err := useCase.Handle(context.Background(), domain.TeacherAssistance{
		EventID:          "11111111-1111-4111-8111-111111111111",
		StudentID:        "22222222-2222-4222-8222-222222222222",
		CorrelationID:    "33333333-3333-4333-8333-333333333333",
		CausationID:      "55555555-5555-4555-8555-555555555555",
		LearningActionID: "33333333-3333-4333-8333-333333333333",
		ContextType:      domain.LearningContextLessonTask,
		ContextID:        "44444444-4444-4444-8444-444444444444",
		SupportContext:   domain.TeacherSupportGuided,
		HintsUsed:        1,
		MaxHintLevel:     &hintLevel,
		Observations: []domain.TeacherAssistanceObservation{
			{
				Target: domain.LearningTargetRef{Type: domain.LearningTargetCapability, Key: "go.errors.wrap"},
				Kind:   domain.TeacherObservationGuidedContext,
			},
			{
				Target: domain.LearningTargetRef{Type: domain.LearningTargetCapability, Key: "go.errors.wrap"},
				Kind:   domain.TeacherObservationHintUsed,
			},
		},
		PolicyVersion: "teacher-assistance-v1",
		OccurredAt:    time.Now(),
	})
	if err != nil {
		t.Fatalf("Handle returned error: %v", err)
	}
	if !applied || repository.calls != 1 {
		t.Fatalf("applied = %v, calls = %d", applied, repository.calls)
	}
	if repository.assistance.Observations[0].Target.Key != "go.errors.wrap" {
		t.Fatalf("unexpected persisted target: %+v", repository.assistance.Observations[0].Target)
	}
}

func TestApplyTeacherAssistanceRejectsInvalidInputBeforePersistence(t *testing.T) {
	repository := &learningEvidenceRepositoryStub{applied: true}
	useCase := ApplyTeacherAssistance{Evidence: repository}

	if _, err := useCase.Handle(context.Background(), domain.TeacherAssistance{}); err == nil {
		t.Fatal("expected invalid assistance error")
	}
	if repository.calls != 0 {
		t.Fatalf("repository calls = %d, want 0", repository.calls)
	}
}
